    How to read the comparison

      Controller setpoint tests

      Each PI loop from the nominal steady state, sensor noise on: setpoint step up at 5 min, back to the design value at 45 min, run to 85 min. Pass = output moves the right way and PV ends within 20 % of the step (or two deadbands) after both steps, no SIF, no priority-1 alarm. PNG plots of the same runs are in benchmark_results/loop_plots/.
